summary: Drive and anger merge imagination and longing. This concentrated pattern asks you to use courage and compassion with awareness.
body: Drive and anger merge imagination and longing. This concentrated pattern asks you to use courage and compassion with awareness. Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. These drives sit close together, so the pattern may feel natural, immediate, and hard to separate. In practice, this can show up through drive and anger, imagination and longing, and the choices you make when reactivity or confusion starts running the room.
gift: The gift is courage, compassion, and a more conscious way to work with drive and anger and imagination and longing.
shadow: The shadow is reactivity, confusion, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let drive and anger and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
do: Name how drive and anger and imagination and longing are both involved
Turn courage and compassion into one concrete choice
dont: Assume what feels natural is automatically balanced
Ignore the needs of drive and anger or imagination and longing
